set.body: The predeclared 20/40/80-update real-MRI learning study is exposing an exportability limit rather than a simple lack of iterations. Frozen development source 5b2105a7c852d9b1eed3f60c9dc43285ace3908a0ba24fdebf607ae3070f03f9; protocol docs/benchmarks/evidence/real-mri-calibration-20261011/development-protocol.json. All first six longer fits fail unchanged checks. At 40 total updates: OASIS 11-to-12 native residual inverse max 0.3687 mm, independent brain roundtrip 0.2235 mm; 15-to-16 native inverse 0.9126 mm and reverse brain roundtrip 0.338 mm; 1-to-10 improves forward Dice to 0.441 but brain roundtrip reaches 0.389 mm. At 80 updates, 1-to-10 fails the shrink-1 transition with fixed accumulated minimum Jacobian 0.00745; 11-to-12 and 15-to-16 inverse errors worsen. Rejected maps remain diagnostic only. Complete study outcomes will be added after fitting. Investigate accumulated-update geometry controls, inverse representation/refinement error, and pyramid transition consistency without relaxing existing anatomical or geometry gates.
set.title: Make larger HalfFlow updates satisfy accumulated topology and inverse export limits
